findings.summary: S5.6.7's answered arm checks that the prompt contains `<homes>\coai-vh`, but `QuestionRowLaunch` makes the copies in the row's own scratch folder: `MakeScratch` is `Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory("coai-question-")`, and `OneShotAsync(scratch, …)` puts them at `<scratch>\tree`. `PromptNaming(place.Roots)` names those paths, so this assertion fails on every host where the test runs.
findings.fix: Do as the Vibe test does (`AVibeQuestionRowReadsACopyOfItsRootsTests.cs:124`): check that the prompt contains the copy under the shim request's `WorkingDirectory` (`--cwd`, `<scratch>\tree\src`) and does not contain `Repo\src`. Then run the case and watch it go green.

findings.summary: All 8 new scenario cases (S5.5.1–S5.5.4 and S5.6.7) start with `Assert.SkipUnless(OperatingSystem.IsWindows())`, so neither red nor green was ever seen (deviation 34), and that is how R1 was missed. The skip is not needed: they use the same `WindowsStandIn` + `KimiSeams.Using(HostKind.Windows, …)` stand-in as `AKimiConsultationScenarioTests`. That class has no skip, and it passed on this Linux host (86 passed in the story's classes; E5.4 deviation 23 says the stand-in runs on every OS).
findings.fix: Remove the Windows skip in both classes (`AKimiConsultantCheckTests` and `AKimiQuestionRowTests.cs:140`), or record a measured reason why these paths need real Windows. Run the 8 cases, watch each red with the table's message (a temporary break of the deciding line), then green, and update deviation 34.

findings.summary: In S5.6.7, the *Then* says that after each ending the row's scratch AND `coai-vh\<8>` are gone. The test checks only `coai-vh`. Nothing checks that the `coai-question-*` folder that holds the copies was removed.
findings.fix: Record the scratch path, for example as the parent of `--cwd`'s `tree` in the answered arm, or through a `MakeScratch` that the test controls. Then check that it is gone after every ending.

findings.summary: S5.5.2 discards the check's result and does not check that a shim was launched. `OneShotEntries` also reads an absent `coai-vh` as empty. So a check that refused before it reserved or launched anything would pass both arms with no real test.
findings.fix: Check that `played.Shims` has a single entry with a `--home` under `<homes>\coai-vh`, and check the state for each arm (answered, or failed for exit 70) before the disposal checks.

findings.summary: `MustCarryNoFlags` also refuses a plan with `Leading` arguments (deviation 33), but no test covers that branch. S5.6.6 sets only `Flags`, and no test in the suite sets `Leading` for kimi.
findings.fix: Add a `Leading = ["--x"]` case to `APlanWithFlags_IsRefusedForKimi` (a Theory), and watch it red with the `Leading` check removed.

findings.summary: The status line says "the Kimi check proved in a copy on a one-shot home", but deviation 34 says the E5.5 and S5.6.7 tests were never seen green on any host.
findings.fix: Write the status as it is (tests written, not yet observed), or change it after R1 and R2 are fixed and the cases have run green.

findings.summary: The section says it is numbered from 31 "so the stories … do not collide on a number", but its items 40–45 have the same numbers as E5.7's deviations 40–45. Deviations 39, 40 and 42 also cite things that are not in this repository: the coder notes `T3-t1-code.md` and `T3-t2-code.md`, the task labels t1, t3 and t4, and a `common.md`. The test commands are in `.agents/PROJECT.md`.
findings.fix: Renumber to a free range (for example 47–61, or a letter prefix like B1–B11), cite `.agents/PROJECT.md`, and put in the facts the notes hold instead of pointers to files outside the repository.

findings.summary: The because-text of `TheOneShotFolderIsEmpty` is the spec's expected-red sentence ("Expected Directory.Exists(…) to be False"). That is not the reason for the assertion, and on a failure FluentAssertions prints a confusing double message.
findings.fix: Give the reason instead, for example "the row's one-shot folder goes on every ending, junction-first".
